text:
elaine: FYI planning a staggered cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Components: API v3.2.1, runtime v9.8.0 (kernel patch), router v1.5.0 (header split), console v2.0.0-beta. Need to agree pin/order, canary windows, and release-note embargo. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: ETA looks fine. Quick Q — does runtime need to go before router because of KV cache layout change?

chen: Router header split touches how the console reads routing headers. Console needs a small client change or router must be pinned behind console. Right now console beta has the change disabled by default.

elaine: My preference is minimal blast radius: API -> runtime -> router -> console, rollback reverse. But if router depends on console schema we should move console earlier.

sam: Runtime patch includes kernel selection logic that API can hit immediately. If we do API first then runtime we risk API using new runtime kernels prematurely. Could we gate at API with a header? e.g. `x-experiment-runtime:v9` so only canary traffic hits new runtime.

chen: Yes we can. Add a temporary header flag. Deploybot can inject headers for canary slices. Also we should avoid making router changes that drop old headers. Router change has a compatibility flag `preserve-old-headers` — keep it on for the first 2 waves.

deploy-bot: Scheduled waves created by @elaine:
- wave-1 (API v3.2.1) 2024-03-15 23:00 UTC — canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% (10m steps)
- wave-2 (Runtime v9.8.0) 23:15 UTC — gated by API header `x-experiment-runtime` (5% -> 25%)
- wave-3 (Router v1.5.0) 23:35 UTC — `preserve-old-headers=true` for first 20m
- wave-4 (Console v2.0.0-beta) 23:55 UTC — feature-flag off, then enable after verification

deploy-bot: Rollback hooks registered: `rollback/api`, `rollback/runtime`, `rollback/router`, `rollback/console`. To rollback run: `deployctl rollback <service> --to-last-stable`

ops-runbook-bot: Rollback criteria (automatic alerts):
```
p50_latency_api > 200ms for 5m
error_rate_api > 1% for 5m
runtime_gpu_failures >= 2 nodes in 10m
router_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m
console_ui_errors spike > 3x baseline for 10m
```
If triggered, run rollback for the last changed service, pause subsequent waves, notify #incidents and @oncall.

sam: Action items: I'll own runtime rollout and watch kernel metrics. I'll set API header gating.

chen: I'll own router rollout and set `preserve-old-headers=true` for initial window. I'll coordinate a console quickpatch if needed.

elaine: I'll handle release notes and the embargo. Draft snippet for notes: "Kernel optimizations to reduce runtime latency; header-splitting to improve routing; console client adjustments for header schema." Keep embargo until 00:30 UTC.

sam: Can we add a quick smoke test after runtime wave that calls API with `x-experiment-runtime:v9` and asserts KV cache parity?

chen: Yep. Test script: `scripts/smoke/runtime-kv-check.sh --header x-experiment-runtime:v9`. Will run in the canary runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary observability hooks attached: metrics: latency/p50/p95, error rates, kernel OOM, router header drops. Alerts will auto-pause waves but require manual confirm to rollback.

elaine: tagging @oncall — please be on-call for escalation from 23:00–01:00 UTC. If anything looks off, pause wave and call it out. :phone: 

sam: noted. I'll keep a console open and push immediate rollback if runtime kernel OOMs spike.

chen: I'll monitor router header metrics and console integration logs.

elaine: OK — final decision: order = API (23:00) -> Runtime (23:15) -> Router (23:35, preserve-old-headers) -> Console (23:55, behind FF). Rollback reverse. Release notes embargo until 00:30 UTC. Everyone please ack. :thumbsup: 

sam: ack

chen: ack

deploy-bot: wave-1 initiated 23:00 UTC — canary 5%

deploy-bot: wave-1 metrics steady at 5% for 10m, no alerts. Proceed to 25%.

deploy-bot: wave-1 at 25%, all green. Waiting 10m before 100%.

(continued in runbook)
